objective: GATE 3F-E MINIMAL IDEMPOTENCY GUARD DESIGN. Diseñar, sin ejecutar migraciones ni writes, el cambio mínimo y reversible requerido en EDARSAHUB para impedir doble ejecución de pagos y permitir un futuro canary fail-closed. Usar evidencia runtime de Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue y Finanzas_Pagos. Determinar si el guard debe vivir en queue, pagos o ambos; qué clave determinista debe proteger; qué constraint/index sería necesario; y cómo preservar compatibilidad con estado actual. No implementar nada.

queries.name: f3e_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3e_queue_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3e_queue_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: f3e_pagos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3e_pagos_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: f3e_active_queue_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS activos FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1

queries.name: f3e_duplicate_decision_hash
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT DecisionPagoID,HashOrigen,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY DecisionPagoID,HashOrigen HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3e_duplicate_hash_amount
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT HashOrigen,ImporteAPagar,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY HashOrigen,ImporteAPagar HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3e_pagos_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Finanzas_Pagos

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
DO NOT add columns or indexes
Design only: identify minimum reversible schema guard
Prefer structural idempotency over application-only checks
Do not hardcode ERP-specific identifiers into generic EDARSAHUB schema unless strictly required
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
